sections.description:
Blockenberg is an advanced Gutenberg block library with 645 lightweight Gutenberg blocks, 683 editable page templates across 76 collections, 3,002 ready-made sections and an AI Agent for WordPress. Build landing pages, business sites, blogs, documentation, comparison pages, review content, interactive tools, and rich editorial layouts faster — all inside the native block editor.

Visit the Blockenberg website

Template Library

Start with a complete page design instead of a blank canvas. Explore 683 editable page templates across 76 collections for business websites, landing pages, portfolios, and more.

  • Find designs with live search, categories, tags, and Free/Pro filters.
  • Preview layouts on desktop, tablet, and mobile before importing.
  • Import a template as a draft and customize its text, images, colors, and layout in Gutenberg.
  • Choose from free templates or unlock premium designs with Blockenberg Pro.

Section Library

Build a page section by section. Browse 3,002 ready-made sections extracted from our templates, including hero areas, features, pricing, testimonials, teams, FAQs, contact layouts, and more. Each section includes a description and searchable tags.

  • Search by purpose, content, industry, or style, and filter by section type, collection, and Free/Pro access.
  • Preview a section on desktop, tablet, or mobile.
  • In Gutenberg, add the Blockenberg Sections block with the + inserter, or click Sections in the editor toolbar to browse and insert at your chosen position. Use Add section below the last block to append a section to the end of the page.
  • Customize the inserted blocks, add or remove cards, and move or duplicate complete sections.
  • Sections from free templates are free; sections from Pro templates require an active Blockenberg Pro license to insert.

Explore Template Library

Instead of combining multiple block plugins, Blockenberg gives you one consistent toolkit with shared design controls, responsive settings, modern styling options, and performance-focused frontend output.

Block categories include:
– Layout & page building: sections, rows, columns, hero areas, bento grids, feature layouts, comparison sections, pricing layouts, and conversion-focused page sections.
– Content & editorial: accordions, blockquotes, styled lists, timelines, FAQs, article series, glossary-style content, reading blocks, and structured content modules.
– Marketing & conversion: call-to-action blocks, pulsing buttons, countdowns, announcement bars, trust bars, promo sections, coupons, pricing sliders, and lead-generation layouts.
– Media & interactive: Google Maps, YouTube and Vimeo performance embeds, video popup buttons, before/after sliders, marquees, carousels, logo showcases, sliders, and interactive cards.
– Social proof & business: team members, testimonials, star ratings, review boxes, business hours, contact blocks, logo carousels, contributor boxes, and profile-style blocks.
– Charts, calculators & utility tools: data tables, progress bars, counters, charts, planners, converters, calculators, comparison tools, and other interactive widgets.

From simple content blocks to advanced interactive elements, Blockenberg is built for speed, accessibility, and everyday real-world publishing.

AI Agent:
Open the AI Agent sidebar in the block editor and describe what to build. It inserts and edits Blockenberg blocks on the page. Powered by OpenRouter, including free models, so you can start without a paid plan. You can also connect a local Codex, Claude, or Cursor session to the same open editor.

Explore AI Agent

Key Features:
– 645 blocks covering page building, content, marketing, media, business, charts, utilities, and more
– Template Library — 683 editable page templates across 76 collections and 3,002 ready-made sections
– AI Agent in the editor — build and edit pages in chat via OpenRouter (free models included) or Codex, Claude, and Cursor
– Consistent controls for colors, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, layout, and responsiveness
– Accessibility-first design with keyboard support and thoughtful frontend behavior
– Performance-focused output with lightweight frontend assets and modern interaction patterns
– Built with standard WordPress components for a native block editor experience
– Works with modern themes and supports a wide range of site types and niches

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/blockenberg directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Add Blockenberg blocks to your pages or posts using the WordPress block editor.
sections.faq:
Are these blocks compatible with my theme?

Yes! Blockenberg blocks are designed to work with any modern, well-coded WordPress theme.

Can I customize the blocks?

Absolutely. Each block offers extensive customization options in the block editor sidebar, including colors, typography, layout, and more.

Are the blocks accessible?

Yes. All blocks are built with accessibility in mind, including keyboard navigation and ARIA labels.

Which templates are free?

Templates marked Free in the Template Library can be imported without Blockenberg Pro. Use the Free filter to find them. Templates marked Pro require an active Blockenberg Pro license to import.

Do I need Blockenberg Pro to use the plugin?

No. The Gutenberg block library, free templates and AI Agent are available in the free plugin. Blockenberg Pro is a separate companion that unlocks premium template imports. The AI Agent uses your own OpenRouter connection; model availability and usage costs depend on the selected model and provider.

Can I edit an imported template?

Yes. Templates are imported as draft pages with native Blockenberg blocks. Open the draft in the WordPress block editor to customize text, images, colors, typography and layouts before publishing.

What happens to imported pages if I deactivate Blockenberg Pro?

Existing imported pages keep their content and saved styles. You can continue to edit them with the free Blockenberg plugin active. Importing additional premium templates requires Blockenberg Pro and an active license.

Can I insert individual sections instead of importing a complete page?

Yes. Open the Sections tab in the Template Library, use the Sections toolbar button, click Add section below the last block, or add the Blockenberg Sections block in Gutenberg. Search, preview, and insert a section into your current page, then edit its blocks. The section inherits the Free or Pro access of its source template. Already inserted sections remain editable and visible with the base Blockenberg plugin active, even if Pro is later deactivated.

sections.reviews:
Could be amazing...

By traybobs on October 14, 2026

I really, really wanted to love this plugin, as it has pretty much everything you could possibly need to build out a website. However, once you start diving into the individual blocks, the issues quickly become apparent.

For example, the File Download Block was exactly what I needed for my site. Unfortunately, when editing the block, if you click away out of it and then click back on it, you can no longer edit it at all. The only solution is to delete it and start again!

The Image Accordion is another block I was really keen to use, but it simply won't display any images. The same issue seems to affect several of the other image-based blocks, which is incredibly frustrating.

On top of that, the plugin doesn't seem to play nicely with Kadence. It can cause the page to scroll erratically up and down on its own, making the editing experience even more frustrating.

It's such a shame because this plugin has the potential to be one of the best out there. I'd happily pay considerably more for the premium version if these issues were resolved. However, rather than continually introducing new blocks, I feel the priority should be fixing and improving the ones that already exist.

I've also submitted a support request but, unfortunately, haven't received a response. That's ultimately why I've decided to leave this review.

I'm genuinely gutted, because there's so much potential here. With better stability, properly functioning blocks and responsive support, this could be an absolutely brilliant plugin. I really hope the developers take these issues seriously and focus on getting the existing features working as they should.

Astonishing

By jamtpg23 on June 28, 2026

This plugin apparently replaces multiple paid plugins. It's nicer, easier, and full featured to a level you won't believe. I kind of don't believe it myself. I do wish all plugins were designed like this. And I don't think I will ever finish trying all the blocks.

Another "how is this free" jaw drop

By antboost on June 3, 2026

I don’t know who decided Blockenberg should be free, but I hope they’re having an absolutely spectacular day and continue to have spectacular days for the rest of their existence. This plugin is ridiculously good. Clean blocks, zero fuss, no friction, snazzy UX and UI. I keep waiting for a catch to jump out and yell “SURPRISE! YOU MUST NOW PAY WITH A BLOOD SACRIFICE OR WE’LL DESTROY EVERY SINGLE SITE YOU HAVE EVER BUILT,” but nope…it’s just excellent. An absolute gem.

Simply amazing

A treasure trove of Gutenberg blocks! This plugin completely transformed my dull LearnPress course into a professional-looking website. The number of features it introduces-and how great they look-is truly amazing.

Technical support is equally good. I reported an issue and it was fixed with an update within hours.
